create.name: Marci Moberg
create.bio:
Marci Moberg describes herself as an intuitive soul guide and mystic. She grew up in the Midwest, studied in Cairo in her early twenties and spent about ten years working on conflict and peace-building at USAID in Washington, alongside a graduate degree in conflict analysis. A period of feeling lost despite outward success sent her on a wide-ranging spiritual search with teachers and mentors from several traditions, and she is also a long-time yoga teacher, trained through Sri Dharma Mitra's 500- and 800-hour programmes, who has led the movement sessions on retreats run by the Aloka Vihara nuns.

Her work now centres on helping sensitive people trust their inner voice. She mentors newer healing practitioners and others on a spiritual path in one-to-one sessions, supports clients through career and relationship changes, and runs Intuition Unlocked, a self-paced course on developing intuition. She also carries a tobacco and tree dieta lineage from the Amazon and guides small groups through eight-day dietas held at home, with daily one-to-one calls and dreamwork. She hosts the podcast Tune In with Marci and lives in the greater Washington, DC area.

courses.title: Intuition Unlocked
courses.description: A self-paced online programme in lessons that start with telling the heart's knowing from the mind's chatter and move on to spirit guides, ancestors and signs. Each lesson pairs teaching with a meditation or ritual.

courses.title: Spiritual Mentoring
courses.description: Regular one-to-one Zoom sessions for people deepening a spiritual path and for practitioners in their first years of healing work. Sessions cover intuitive gifts, shadow work and keeping sacred work and personal life in balance; day-long one-to-one intensives are also offered.

courses.title: Navigating Life Transitions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions by Zoom for people changing career, ending or beginning a relationship, or moving, using intuition alongside practical planning. Monthly packages of two or three sessions are available.

courses.title: Sacred Tree and Tobacco Dietas
courses.description: An eight-day plant dieta in the Mamancunawa tobacco lineage, kept at home with a daily one-to-one Zoom session and work with dreams. Groups are small, with intake, orientation and integration calls; a few in-person dietas are possible near Washington, DC.

free_resources.title: Hear Your Inner Voice: free intuition masterclass
free_resources.description: A free recorded class, sent by email, on telling fear apart from intuition and building trust in inner guidance. It closes with a heart-centred meditation.
